# SHDmedian

`SHDmedian()` retains the exact bivariate cutting-plane implementation.
`SHDmedian_approx()` adds finite-direction SDP optimization in any dimension,
with a fixed center supplied explicitly:

``` r
set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(300), 100, 3)
fit <- SHDmedian_approx(X, center = rep(0, 3), n_directions = 200, seed = 42)
fit$Sigma
fit$depth_U
fit$search_bounds
```

The approximate method defaults to the positive definite domain. Use
`domain = "psd"` for semidefinite matrices. Inspect `status`, `search_bounds`,
and `levels` for numerical uncertainty. `depth_U` uses raw inclusive counts
on the returned fixed directions; it is an upper bound on full directional
depth. The selected matrix is not a barycenter of the median set.

See `doc/approximate-median.md`, `examples/approx.R`, and
`benchmarks/approx.R` for numerical details, independent validation, and
reproducible timings. The approximation requires the optional `clarabel`
package (`install.packages("clarabel")`).
